feature_contract.goal: Preserve a complete stage +TIME transition in a single stereo-owned HUD layer for both queued sprites and immediate numeric glyphs, including delayed D3DX draws when Begin starts after node selection.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only exact ScreenHud StageExtensionTime producer and first clean queued D3DX Draw; preserve GOAL/rank/F11, native timer, unrelated sprite batches, R84 world/SkyGlow and device recovery.
trace_stages: Six 0x989xx original +TIME sprite and numeric E8 calls publish separate direct and queued StageExtensionTime semantic.
D3DX Begin can start after SpriteQueueNode selection, clearing StageBoundaryReady; Draw now re-arms only first homogeneous exact-owner batch.
Queued +TIME GPU triangles flush before queue End/owner change; original R84 eye GPU dispatch and host are unchanged.
subcomponents: Preserve existing direct +TIME numeric glyph pre/post-scope batch splitting and all six producer hook identities.
Fix queued +TIME deferred sprite batches by restoring exact submission boundary after a late D3DX Begin.
Guard scope/texture/Reset/GOAL/rank fallbacks with compile-time assertions and changed-area mutation regression.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Stage +TIME queued sprites and direct numeric glyph producers
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Rearm queue-end submission on the first exact +TIME Draw after late D3DX Begin while direct numeric glyphs retain their source-exit submission.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: D3DX mixed/foreign source, GOAL, rank, fallback and Reset
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Reject invalid queue, batch, sprite, count, producer and scope; preserve original HRESULT, GOAL/DispRank and device lifecycle.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: R84 32-bit D3D9 game and 64-bit OpenXR host
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Exact validation-bearing source SHA passes DX9Ex Active x86 game/full-chain x64 host package, Domain and affected Source Impact/HUD gates; Quest3 tested separately.

diagnosis.original_evidence: BeforeQueueNode sets StageBoundaryReady=false when BatchActive is false; later BeginDest also clears this flag. DrawDest previously returned immediately for exactStage without rearming the queue End boundary.
source_trace: Original six source E8 hooks tag +TIME direct numeric and queued SpriteNode producer as StageExtensionTime ScreenHud.
Canonical SelectSpriteQueueNode may run before D3DX Begin; BeginDest clears StageBoundaryReady after that selection.
Successful DrawDest records first exact sprite batch but previously returned without rearming the BeforeQueueEnd Flush; GPU submission can outlive the queue's ScreenHud owner.
diagnosis.root_cause: An exact queued +TIME first Draw performed after a late D3DX Begin fails to restore the cleared queue-exit batch boundary.
alternatives_rejected: Do not globally Flush after every Draw or modify the game time tick: it would reorder texture batching and steal unrelated D3DX owners.
Do not treat GOAL, DispRank or world effects as stage extension sources to hide a missing queue owner.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: CanArmD3DXQueueStageAfterDraw requires live queue, active exact sprite Begin, first homogeneous Draw, and matching StageExtensionTime ScreenHud pending/current source before rearming the queue boundary.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Nine constexpr assertions cover first-owned positive and queue/batch/sprite/second-draw/mixed/GOAL/wrong-scope/token negatives; updated mutation verifier rejects bypassed guards and omitted rearm.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: R84 R33 stereo composition remains unchanged; stage ScreenHud queue owner now persists through D3DX Flush until its GPU draw occurs.

runtime_evidence: No actual Quest3/VDXR game-screen test performed.
